no_rule_decisions.reason: Technical: choose SEND MAP with or without ERASE; SEND-ERASE-YES is always set at entry.

observations.text: SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN always ends with GO TO RETURN-TO-CICS, so every PERFORM of it terminates the task; the later 'IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON' tests only matter on paths where no screen was sent. Error handling depends on this implicit exit.

The IS NOT NUMERIC checks run after each date part has been converted with NUMVAL-C and moved back from a PIC 99/9999 field, so they can no longer detect non-numeric input; invalid characters are left to NUMVAL-C, whose result for invalid input is not defined (Inferred).
CEEDAYS message number 2513 (X'09D1', FC-UNSUPP-RANGE in CSUTLDTC) is accepted as a valid date, so dates outside the CEEDAYS supported range pass validation.
There is no check that the custom start date is on or before the end date.
JOB-LINES OCCURS 1000 TIMES redefines JOB-DATA-1, which holds only 17 80-byte lines; the loop relies on the '/*EOF' terminator to avoid reading beyond the deck.

JCL is hardcoded: job TRNRPT00 CLASS=A MSGCLASS=0, NOTIFY=&SYSUID (symbolic left for JES, not resolved here), JCLLIB AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC, PROC TRANREPT, step overrides STEP05R.SYMNAMES and STEP10R.DATEPARM.

SYMNAMES offsets TRAN-CARD-NUM,263,16 and TRAN-PROC-DT,305,10 are hardcoded; they match TRAN-CARD-NUM (bytes 263-278) and the date part of TRAN-PROC-TS (from byte 305) in CVTRA05Y, so a record layout change would silently break the report.
TDQ name 'JOBS' is hardcoded; that it is an extrapartition queue routed to the JES internal reader is stated only in the header comment (Unverified, depends on the CICS DCT/TDQUEUE definition).
No user-type or authorization check is made before submitting the batch job; any user who can run CR00 can submit the report job.
WS-TRANSACT-FILE, TRANSACT-EOF, WS-REC-COUNT, WS-TRAN-AMT, WS-TRAN-DATE and the CVTRA05Y record are declared but not used; SEND without ERASE branch is unreachable.
DISPLAY statements are used in a CICS program (output goes to the CICS job log).
RECEIVE MAP RESP/RESP2 are captured but never tested.

paragraphs.logic: Resets the error, EOF and erase flags and clears the message. With EIBCALEN 0 it XCTLs to COSGN00C; otherwise it loads CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and on first entry sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER and sends an empty screen. On re-entry it receives the map and evaluates EIBAID: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, PF3 -> XCTL to COMEN01C, other keys -> 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'. It ends with CICS RETURN TRANSID(CR00).
paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA

paragraphs.logic: Determines the report period from the first non-blank selection field: Monthly (first to last day of the current month), Yearly (01-01 to 12-31 of the current year) or Custom (screen dates, which must be present, numeric, month <= 12, day <= 31 and valid per CSUTLDTC). Dates are moved into PARM-START/END-DATE-1/2 of the JCL deck and SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR is performed; no selection gives 'Select a report type to print report...'. If no error, the fields are cleared and '<name> report submitted for printing ...' is shown in green.
paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY

paragraphs.logic: Requires the CONFIRM field: blank asks 'Please confirm to print the <name> report...'; 'N'/'n' clears the fields and redisplays; any value other than 'Y'/'y' gives '"<value>" is not a valid value to confirm...'. When confirmed it loops over JOB-LINES (max 1000), moving each to JCL-RECORD and writing it to the TDQ until a line equal to '/*EOF', spaces or low-values has been written.
paragraphs.name: SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR

paragraphs.logic: Writes the 80-byte JCL-RECORD to transient data queue 'JOBS'. A non-NORMAL response DISPLAYs RESP/RESP2, sets the error flag and sends 'Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...'.
paragraphs.name: WIRTE-JOBSUB-TDQ

paragraphs.logic: Defaults CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM to COSGN00C when blank, records CR00/CORPT00C as the from-transaction/program, zeroes CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT and XCTLs to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM with the commarea.
paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Fills the header, moves WS-MESSAGE to ERRMSGO and sends map CORPT0A (with ERASE when SEND-ERASE-YES, which is always set), then GO TO RETURN-TO-CICS so the task ends immediately after any screen send.
paragraphs.name: SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Issues CICS RETURN TRANSID(CR00) with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA to wait for the next user input.
paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-CICS

paragraphs.logic: Receives map CORPT0A of mapset CORPT00 into CORPT0AI; RESP/RESP2 are captured but not tested.
paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-TRNRPT-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Moves FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE to WS-CURDATE-DATA, CCDA-TITLE01/CCDA-TITLE02 to TITLE01O/TITLE02O, WS-TRANID to TRNNAMEO and WS-PGMNAME to PGMNAMEO of CORPT0AO; rebuilds the date as WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY (MM/DD/YY from WS-CURDATE-MONTH, WS-CURDATE-DAY, WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2)) into CURDATEO and the time as WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS into CURTIMEO.
paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO

paragraphs.logic: Puts the cursor on the Monthly field and initializes all selection, date and confirm input fields and WS-MESSAGE.
paragraphs.name: INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: XCTL to COSGN00C/COMEN01C, screen sent, or invalid-key message
rules.statement: Without a commarea the program returns to the sign-on program COSGN00C. On first entry it shows the report selection screen; afterwards ENTER processes the request, PF3 returns to the main menu COMEN01C and any other key shows 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.

rules.anchor: COMPUTE WS-CURDATE-N = FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER( FUNCTION INTEGER-OF-DATE(WS-CURDATE-N) - 1)
rules.conditions: Monthly selection field not spaces/low-values (checked first)
rules.statement: Monthly report: the reporting period runs from the first day of the current month (YYYY-MM-01) to the last day of the current month, computed as the day before the first day of the next month (with year roll-over after December).

rules.conditions: Yearly selection field not spaces/low-values and Monthly blank
rules.statement: Yearly report: the reporting period is January 1 to December 31 of the current year. It applies only when Monthly is not selected.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Start Date - Month can NOT be empty...'
rules.conditions: Custom selected (Monthly and Yearly blank) and a date part is spaces/low-values

rules.statement: Custom report: start month, start day, start year, end month, end day and end year are all required, checked in that order; the first empty one is reported ('Start Date - Month can NOT be empty...' etc.) and processing stops.

rules.anchor: IF SDTMMI OF CORPT0AI IS NOT NUMERIC OR SDTMMI OF CORPT0AI > '12'
rules.conditions: Converted date part not numeric or out of range
messages: Start Date - Not a valid Month...
Start Date - Not a valid Day...
Start Date - Not a valid Year...
End Date - Not a valid Month...
End Date - Not a valid Day...
End Date - Not a valid Year...
rules.outcome: Error message, screen sent, task ends
rules.statement: Custom report dates: each part is converted with NUMVAL-C; month must be numeric and not greater than 12, day numeric and not greater than 31, and year numeric, for both start and end date; the first failure is reported ('Start Date - Not a valid Month...' etc.).

messages: Start Date - Not a valid date...
End Date - Not a valid date...
rules.outcome: Error message, screen sent, task ends
rules.statement: Custom start and end dates (YYYY-MM-DD) must be valid calendar dates according to CSUTLDTC/CEEDAYS. A non-zero severity is rejected ('Start Date - Not a valid date...' / 'End Date - Not a valid date...') except when the CEEDAYS message number is 2513, which is accepted.

messages: report submitted for printing ...
rules.statement: A custom report is submitted only when no validation error was raised; on success of any report the selection fields are cleared and '<Monthly|Yearly|Custom> report submitted for printing ...' is shown in green.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Select a report type to print report...' TO WS-MESSAGE
messages: Select a report type to print report...
rules.outcome: Error message, cursor on Monthly, screen sent
rules.statement: If none of Monthly, Yearly or Custom is selected, the request is rejected with 'Select a report type to print report...'. The selection fields are evaluated in priority order Monthly, Yearly, Custom.

rules.outcome: Prompt, cancel, error, or continue to job submission
rules.statement: The report job is submitted only after explicit confirmation: a blank CONFIRM field asks 'Please confirm to print the <name> report...'; 'N' or 'n' cancels and clears the screen; any value other than 'Y'/'y'/'N'/'n' is rejected with '"<value>" is not a valid value to confirm...'.

rules.anchor: IF JCL-RECORD = '/*EOF' OR JCL-RECORD = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES
rules.conditions: Confirmed with Y/y and no error
rules.outcome: EXEC CICS WRITEQ TD QUEUE('JOBS') for each JCL line
rules.statement: Job submission: the in-storage JCL deck (job TRNRPT00, JCLLIB AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC, EXEC PROC=TRANREPT, SYMNAMES TRAN-CARD-NUM,263,16,ZD and TRAN-PROC-DT,305,10,CH, PARM-START-DATE/PARM-END-DATE symbols and a DATEPARM card with start and end date) is written one 80-byte line at a time to TDQ 'JOBS', up to and including the first line that is '/*EOF', spaces or low-values (maximum 1000 lines) or until an error occurs.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...' TO WS-MESSAGE
messages: Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...
rules.outcome: Error message; task ends via SEND-TRNRPT-SCREEN
rules.statement: If any write to TDQ 'JOBS' fails, the RESP/RESP2 codes are DISPLAYed, the error flag is set and 'Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...' is shown; lines already written are not removed.
When returning to a previous screen and no target program is set, the sign-on program COSGN00C is used.

sme_questions.question: Why is CEEDAYS message 2513 (unsupported date range) treated as a valid date for the custom report dates?
Should the custom report reject an end date earlier than the start date?
Confirm that TDQ 'JOBS' is defined as an extrapartition queue to the JES internal reader in the target CICS region, and how &SYSUID is resolved for jobs submitted from CICS.
Should report submission be restricted by user type (admin vs regular user)?

summary.text: CORPT00C is a pseudo-conversational CICS program (transaction CR00, mapset CORPT00, map CORPT0A) that lets the user request a transaction report to be printed by a batch job. The user selects Monthly (current calendar month), Yearly (current calendar year) or Custom (start and end date typed on the screen); custom dates are checked for presence, numeric month/day/year ranges and calendar validity via the CSUTLDTC subprogram (LE CEEDAYS). After the user confirms with Y, the program fills the start/end dates into an in-storage JCL deck (job TRNRPT00 running procedure TRANREPT from library AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PROC) and writes it line by line to the transient data queue JOBS. It reports 'Monthly/Yearly/Custom report submitted for printing ...' on success or 'Unable to Write TDQ (JOBS)...' on failure. PF3 returns to the main menu COMEN01C; entry without a commarea returns to the sign-on program COSGN00C. Every screen send ends the task (GO TO RETURN-TO-CICS), so the first validation error stops processing.
